title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
Inside Sales Representative North America
 
We are looking for an experienced B2B SaaS / Technology Sales professional to drive new business across the North American retail market, primarily the USA.
This is not a traditional SDR appointment-setting role. You will own the sales journey from prospecting and discovery through product demonstration, commercial discussions, negotiation and closure, working closely with our Sales, Channel and Marketing teams.
You will represent iVend a Unified Retail Management Platform and engage mid-market and enterprise retailers looking to modernize their retail technology landscape.
What You'll Do
 Own and develop a North American territory with a strong focus on new-logo acquisition.
 Prospect and engage target accounts through cold calling, email, LinkedIn, ABM and other outbound channels.
 Identify the right ICP, map accounts and build relationships with multiple stakeholders.
 Engage senior decisionmakers including CIOs, CTOs, IT Directors, Retail Operations and Digital leaders.
 Conduct discovery conversations to understand business challenges, technology environments and buying requirements.
 Lead product demonstrations, solution discussions and commercial conversations.
 Progress qualified opportunities through the sales cycle and support negotiation and closure.
 Work with Channel Sales Managers and partners to develop and accelerate pipeline.
 Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, target accounts and demand generation.
 Maintain accurate CRM data, pipeline visibility and sales forecasting.
 Consistently deliver against pipeline, opportunity, revenue and new-logo targets.
What We're Looking For
 5+ years of B2B SaaS / Enterprise Technology / Inside Sales experience.
 Proven experience selling into the USA and/or Canada.
 Demonstrated success in new-business development and outbound sales.
 Strong consultative selling, discovery and qualification skills.
 Experience selling to mid-market and enterprise customers.
 Ability to engage and influence senior business and technology stakeholders.
 Strong account mapping and multi-threaded prospecting capabilities.
 Experience with CRM and modern sales prospecting tools.
 Retail technology experience is a strong advantage, particularly exposure to POS, ERP, eCommerce, Inventory, Loyalty or Omnichannel platforms.
 Excellent spoken and written English.
 A genuine hunter mentalitypersistent, commercially driven and comfortable creating opportunities from scratch.
 
What Success Looks Like
Your success will be measured by:
New Logos | Qualified Pipeline | Pipeline Coverage | Opportunity Conversion | Deal Velocity | ARR / Revenue
Role Details
Position: Inside Sales / SaaS Sales Executive
Market: North America USA & Canada
Location: Hybrid Noida, India
Working Hours: North American business hours
Employment: Full-time
Reporting to: Director Inside Sales
Why This Role?
If you enjoy opening doors, creating your own pipeline, speaking with senior decision-makers and taking deals from first conversation to commercial closure, this is an opportunity to build a significant North American SaaS business.
If you have successfully sold B2B SaaS or enterprise technology into the US market, we want to hear from you.

 Location - Noida Job Summary Responsible for preparing, reconciling, and validating U.S. Sales and Use Tax returns across multiple states and jurisdictions. Ensure the accuracy of sales data, tax calculations, credit balances, adjustments, and return information before submission for review. Investigate discrepancies, resolve negative tax balances, and ensure compliance with established procedures and filing deadlines. 
 Key Responsibilities Collect, analyze, and validate client-provided sales and tax data. Reconcile gross sales, taxable sales, exempt sales, total tax reported, credits, prepayments, and adjustments. Compare client source data with tax return records to identify and resolve discrepancies. Review tax return details to validate gross sales, taxable amounts, exemptions, tax due, and jurisdiction-specific requirements. Identify and investigate negative tax balances and perform credit reconciliation and allocation. Verify opening credit balances, credits applied, and ending balances to ensure accurate monthly reconciliation. Process authorized adjustments related to gross sales, exemptions, taxable amounts, prepayments, vendor compensation, and other tax differences. Investigate rounding differences and identify the reasons for variances between reported tax and return amounts. Prepare and validate tax returns for multiple states, counties, cities, and other local jurisdictions. Support Business and Occupation (B&O) tax return processing, including wholesale and retail classifications, where applicable. Generate and review updated tax returns after making necessary corrections and adjustments. Maintain appropriate documentation and comments for all adjustments and discrepancies. Update monthly reconciliation records with tax payment amounts, credit adjustments, and other required information. Manage return processing statuses according to the prescribed workflow. Ensure all returns are reconciled and submitted for managerial review and approval before filing. Escalate complex tax discrepancies, unmatched credits, and exceptions to the supervisor. Maintain high levels of accuracy, productivity, and compliance with internal SOPs. Complete assigned returns within defined turnaround times and statutory filing deadlines. Identify recurring errors and suggest process improvements to reduce rework and improve operational efficiency. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. 1–3 years of experience in accounting, tax compliance, financial reconciliation in back-office operations. Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including filters, formulas, lookups, and data reconciliation. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify data inconsistencies. Ability to analyze large datasets and investigate variances independently. Good written communication and documentation skills. Ability to follow standard operating procedures and meet strict deadlines. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple assignments. 
 Preferred Skills Experience in U.S. Sales and Use Tax compliance. Understanding of U.S. state and local tax jurisdictions. Experience in tax return preparation, reconciliation, and credit allocation. Knowledge of tax exemptions, prepayments, vendor compensation, and tax adjustments. Exposure to Business and Occupation (B&O) tax returns. Experience working in a deadline-driven accounting or compliance environment.

 Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart: Working knowledge of EPC, OEM, Global Endusers and process licensors Strong presentation / technology demonstration skills Strong knowledge of strategic account management, the project pursuit lifecycle, and effective customer engagement strategies across all stages of project development and execution

Prepare and present capability decks, sales presentations, solution proposals, use cases, and commercial estimates. Map client requirements to Vinove’s service offerings and develop compelling value propositions to improve conversion rates. Support technical and commercial discussions throughout the sales cycle until successful deal closure. 4. Hands-on experience in pre-sales, solution presentations, proposal development, and commercial negotiations. Ability to understand client requirements and translate them into suitable technology solutions. Experience engaging CXOs, Founders, CTOs, CIOs, and other senior stakeholders. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills. Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, CRM tools, and sales intelligence platforms.

title: Inside Sales Associate
description:
The Inside Sales Associate will own top-of-funnel prospecting for the US market. You will research target accounts, identify the right stakeholders, and engage them through personalized, multichannel outreach. You will also design and run outbound campaigns. The role suits someone who enjoys the detective work of account research and can turn those insights into conversations that lead to qualified meetings. Key Responsibilities 1. Account Research & Targeting Research prospective accounts in depth, covering business priorities, tech stack, growth signals, recent news, funding, leadership changes, and likely pain points. Build and maintain target account lists aligned with SaaSWorx's ideal customer profile and focus industries. Map organizational structures to identify decision-makers, influencers, and champions, such as CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Sales Ops/RevOps, Heads of CRM, and Data & Analytics leaders. 2. Outreach & Engagement Run personalized outreach through email and LinkedIn, writing messages grounded in account-specific insights rather than generic templates. Build and execute multi-touch sequences across channels, adjusting messaging to the persona, industry, and buying stage. Engage prospects through LinkedIn Sales Navigator using connection requests, InMails, and thoughtful content interactions. Qualify prospect interest and book discovery meetings for senior sales and delivery leaders. 3. Outbound Campaign Management Design, launch, and manage outbound campaigns for specific industries, personas, partner offerings, or events. A/B test subject lines, messaging, and cadences, and refine campaigns based on open, reply, and meeting conversion rates. Work with marketing and leadership on campaign themes, value propositions, and collateral. 4. Data, Tools & Reporting Use Apollo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator for prospect discovery, contact enrichment, and sequencing. Keep CRM records accurate, complete, and up to date. Track and report weekly on key metrics, including accounts researched, contacts engaged, response rates, meetings booked, and pipeline generated. Share market and competitive insights gathered through prospecting with the broader team. Required Qualifications Minimum 3 years of experience in inside sales, SDR/BDR, lead generation, or a similar prospecting role. At least 1 year of experience prospecting into the US market. Hands-on proficiency with Apollo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Proven ability to research accounts in depth and identify the right stakeholders in complex, mid-to-large organizations. Excellent written English, with the ability to write concise, personalized, and professional outreach for a US business audience. Strong verbal communication skills and comfort engaging senior executives. Experience building and managing multi-step outbound sequences and campaigns. Willingness to work a shift with at least 4 hours of overlap with US business hours. Preferred Qualifications Experience with a technology consulting, IT services, or SaaS firm. Familiarity with the Salesforce ecosystem, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and related products, as well as adjacent platforms such as Snowflake or NetSuite. Exposure to industries such as Financial Services, Retail, QSR, Private Equity, or Logistics. Experience with CRM platforms, ideally Salesforce, and email sequencing tools. A track record of meeting or exceeding meeting and pipeline targets. Key Attributes Curious and research-oriented: Dig past the surface to understand what matters to a prospect. Self-driven: Manage your own pipeline and activities with minimal supervision. Data-minded: Use metrics to continuously improve outreach. Resilient: Handle rejection well and remain consistent. Collaborative: Work closely with sales, marketing, and delivery teams. What We Offer Direct exposure to the US market and a high-growth consulting business. The opportunity to work alongside a leadership team with deep Salesforce and enterprise consulting expertise. Opportunities to work across leading technology partner ecosystems. Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives. A clear growth path into senior business development and account management roles.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
Job Description Client Relationship & Sales Coordinator Location Noida Employment Type Full-Time About Axiom Design Studio Axiom Design Studio is a premium architecture and luxury interior design firm dedicated to creating timeless homes and meaningful spaces. We believe exceptional design begins with exceptional client experiences. Every interaction with a prospective client reflects our values of professionalism, trust, attention to detail, and thoughtful communication. We are looking for a highly organized, warm, and proactive Client Relationship & Sales Coordinator who will become the custodian of our complete sales journeyfrom the first enquiry to successful project onboarding. Role Summary As the Client Relationship & Sales Coordinator, you will be the first point of contact for all prospective clients. Your role is to ensure that every enquiry is handled promptly, professionally, and thoughtfully. You will own the coordination of our complete sales pipeline, ensuring that no lead is missed, every follow-up happens on time, every proposal reaches the client professionally, and every client enjoys a seamless experience throughout the sales journey. This role is not about aggressive selling. It is about building trust, maintaining relationships, creating organized systems, and ensuring an exceptional client experience. Key Responsibilities 1. Lead Management Be the first point of contact for all new enquiries. Respond to enquiries professionally and promptly. Monitor all lead sources including:

 Website WhatsApp Instagram Facebook LinkedIn Google Email Referrals Phone calls Ensure no enquiry or lead is ever missed. Maintain complete lead records in the CRM. 2. Lead Qualification Qualify prospective clients before scheduling meetings by understanding: Project type Project location Budget range Timeline Decision makers Project requirements Overall alignment with Axiom’s services 3. Client Relationship Management Build professional and warm relationships with prospective clients. Maintain regular communication. Follow up consistently without being intrusive. Address client queries promptly. Ensure every interaction reflects Axiom’s premium brand experience. 4. Meeting Coordination Schedule meetings between clients and the Principal Architect. Coordinate calendars and confirmations. Send meeting reminders. Share meeting links when applicable. Ensure clients are well-informed before every meeting. 5. Meeting Preparation Before every meeting, prepare a concise client briefing including: Client background Project requirements Budget Timeline Previous discussions Lead source Key expectations Special notes or concerns 6. Proposal & Documentation Prepare and share proposals. Send company profile and portfolio. Coordinate revisions and updates. Track proposal status. Ensure timely delivery of all client documents. 7. Post-Meeting Coordination Following every meeting: Send meeting summaries. Share promised documents. Coordinate proposal revisions. Schedule next steps. Maintain continuous follow-up until project closure. 8. Sales Operations Maintain the complete Sales Management System. Update CRM daily. Track every stage of the sales funnel. Maintain accurate client records. Generate weekly and monthly sales reports. Monitor pipeline movement and follow-up schedules. Ensure smooth handover to the design team after project confirmation. 9. Marketing & Sales Support Support the Principal Architect by coordinating: Sales presentations Client-facing documents Sales videos Marketing collateral Social media content related to sales Case studies Client testimonials 10. Reporting & Analytics Prepare regular reports including: Total enquiries received Qualified leads Meetings scheduled Proposals shared Projects won Projects lost Reasons for rejection Lead conversion ratios Pending follow-ups Sales pipeline status Skills & Qualifications We are looking for someone who possesses: Excellent spoken and written English Strong Hindi communication skills Outstanding interpersonal skills Professional phone etiquette Excellent follow-up abilities Strong organizational and coordination skills Good email writing skills Attention to detail Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously Confidence in interacting with high-end clients Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office Familiarity with CRM software (preferred) Basic Canva or presentation skills (preferred) Understanding of social media platforms Personal Attributes The ideal candidate is: Soft-spoken and courteous Naturally persuasive without being pushy Professional and presentable Highly dependable Honest and trustworthy Proactive Patient and calm under pressure Solution-oriented Quick to learn Positive in attitude Emotionally mature Committed to delivering outstanding client experiences Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured through: Zero missed enquiries First response time Follow-up completion rate Meeting scheduling efficiency Proposal turnaround time CRM accuracy Lead-to-meeting conversion Meeting-to-order conversion support Client satisfaction during the sales process Quality and timeliness of reporting Confidentiality This role involves access to confidential client information, pricing, proposals, business strategies, and internal operations. Maintaining complete confidentiality and professionalism at all times is essential. Our Expectations At Axiom Design Studio, we value ownership over supervision. We are looking for someone who takes responsibility, solves problems proactively, follows through on commitments, and ensures that every client receives an exceptional experience. We believe that every interaction matters. Whether a client chooses to work with us or not, they should leave every conversation with a positive impression of Axiom. Preferred Experience 2–5 years of experience in Client Relations, Sales Coordination, Customer Success, Business Development, or Front Office roles. Experience in architecture, interior design, luxury real estate, construction, hospitality, or premium service industries will be an advantage. Why Join Axiom? At Axiom, you won’t simply coordinate sales—you will shape the first impression of our brand. You’ll work closely with the Principal Architect, contribute to building world-class client experiences, and become an integral part of a studio that values design excellence, professionalism, and meaningful relationships. If you enjoy connecting with people, creating order from complexity, and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Sales Manager (IT hardware & Networking Product)
description:
*Please read the JD before applying . 
 Urgent Requirement 
 Role & responsibilities 
 BizAarambh Catalyst Pvt Ltd Client is looking for an experienced and target-driven ASM/Sales Manager to manage sales growth, develop channel partners, handle key customers, and drive business across ISP, Telecom, IT Networking, Wireless, VoIP, and Enterprise segments. The Sales Manager will report to the Zone Head / Regional Sales Head and will be responsible for achieving sales targets, managing dealer/distributor/channel partner relationships, supporting OEM brand sales, handling team coordination, and ensuring timely payment collection and customer satisfaction in the assigned region. The role requires strong knowledge of IT networking products such as routers, switches, wireless devices, access points, VoIP products, fiber/networking products , and brands such as MikroTik, Cambium, Mimosa, Grandstream, Ubiquiti, TP-Link, Cisco, Optitera, or similar products. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Sales and Revenue Generation 
 Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Drive sales for networking, wireless, telecom, VoIP, ISP, and enterprise products. Develop and execute sales plans for the assigned region and product category. Identify new customers, dealers, channel partners, system integrators, ISPs, and enterprise accounts. Manage existing customers and generate repeat business. Drive upselling, cross-selling, and new product sales. Maintain sales pipeline, follow-ups, quotations, order status, and closure reports. Ensure timely customer communication and deal closure. 
 2. Channel Partner and Dealer Management 
 Appoint, develop, and manage channel partners, resellers, dealers, and system integrators. Build strong relationships with ISP, telecom, IT networking, and enterprise customers. Conduct partner engagement activities, product discussions, and sales follow-ups. Support partners with product information, pricing, availability, and schemes. Resolve partner issues related to pricing, delivery, stock, credit, payment, and support. Ensure partners follow company sales process and credit policy. 
 3. Product and Brand Knowledge 
 Maintain strong understanding of networking and telecom products. Understand product-wise and model-wise selling points. Coordinate with the technical team for product selection, compatibility, and customer queries. Promote company key brands and product categories. Understand pricing source, margin, stock availability, and competitor pricing. Participate in product training and ensure team knowledge improvement. 
 4. Team Management 
 Lead, guide, and monitor the sales team. Set daily, weekly, and monthly targets for team members. Review daily activity reports, customer follow-ups, quotations, and closures. Ensure proper CRM/reporting discipline and timely updates from team members. Train team members on customer handling, product knowledge, communication, and closure. Conduct regular sales reviews and performance discussions. 
 5. Business Development 
 Identify new markets, customer segments, and business opportunities. Build business in ISP, telecom, enterprise, system integration, and networking markets. Work closely with OEMs for product promotion, schemes, and business growth. Lead high-value deal discussions, pricing negotiation, and closure. Track competitor activities and market trends. Support expansion of business in assigned territory. 
 6. Coordination and Order Closure 
 Coordinate with Sales Support, Technical Support, Accounts, Operations, Logistics, and Store teams. Ensure smooth order processing from quotation to delivery. Follow up for payment, credit approval, dispatch, invoice, and customer confirmation. Ensure proper closure of every task and customer requirement. Avoid pending work without ownership and timeline. Maintain email documentation for important discussions, commitments, approvals, and reports. 
 7. Payment Collection and Compliance 
 Follow company credit policy and payment terms. Ensure timely payment collection from customers and channel partners. Monitor outstanding payments and receivables. Coordinate with the internal team. 
 Required Skills and Competencies 
 Strong B2B sales and channel sales experience. Good knowledge of IT networking, wireless, telecom, ISP, VoIP, routers, switches, access points, and fiber products. Experience in dealer/distributor/channel partner handling. Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Ability to handle targets and work under pressure. Good customer relationship management skills. Team handling and leadership ability. Good coordination with internal departments. Strong follow-up and closure approach. Basic knowledge of CRM, Excel, email communication, and MIS reporting. Ability to work independently and take ownership. 
 Preferred Product Knowledge 
 MikroTik, Cambium Networks, Mimosa, Grandstream, Ubiquiti, TP-Link, Cisco, Juniper, Digisol, Optitera, AirPro or similar brands. Wireless access points, routers, switches, VoIP/IP phones, fiber networking products, ISP and telecom solutions. Basic understanding of Wi-Fi, wireless, switching, routing, VLAN, Cisco switches/routers, and related networking solutions. 
 Qualification 
 Graduate in any discipline. MBA / PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management will be preferred. Engineering or technical background will be an added advantage. Experience 5 to 8 years of experience in B2B sales. Experience in IT networking, telecom, ISP, wireless, or enterprise sales preferred. Minimum 2 to 3 years of team handling or senior sales responsibility preferred. Experience with channel partners, system integrators, OEMs, and distributors will be an advantage.

title: Senior hardware Sales Manager
description:
Job Description: Hardware Sales Manager 
 We are hiring a Senior Hardware Sales Manager to scale revenue through distributors, resellers, system integrators, and partner networks as part of its hardware growth agenda. The role is best positioned as a channel and distribution leadership hire rather than a generic sales manager because effective hardware growth depends on partner-led go-to-market execution, coverage, forecasting, and relationship ownership across the indirect sales ecosystem. 
 Job Title: Hardware Sales Manager Location: Noida / NCR preferred; open to Pan-India travel Department: Sales / Business Growth Reporting To: CEO / Business Head 
 Key Responsibilities Build and execute the hardware channel sales strategy across regions, partner segments, and product categories to drive revenue growth and market share. Own relationships with distributors, resellers, system integrators, and regional partners; improve partner productivity, sell-through, and market coverage. Recruit, onboard, activate, and grow new channel partners in priority markets and industry verticals. Drive partner-led pipeline creation, deal closures, and repeat business through account planning and structured business reviews. Negotiate pricing, schemes, margins, commercial terms, and growth plans with distributors and strategic partners. Work with OEMs and internal teams on deal registration, incentive programs, promotions, certifications, and partner enablement initiatives. Build forecasting discipline, channel dashboards, review cadences, and operational rigor across pipeline, conversion, collections, and revenue tracking. Lead, coach, and scale the sales team to consistently achieve business targets through strong execution. Collaborate with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to improve demand generation, order fulfillment, and partner experience. Monitor market trends, competitive activities, regional demand shifts, and emerging opportunities across the IT hardware landscape. 
 Candidate Profile Required Experience 815 years of B2B IT hardware sales experience with strong exposure to channel, distribution, and partner-led business models. Proven success in managing distributors, partner ecosystems, and indirect sales across product categories such as PCs, laptops, peripherals, networking, POS solutions, enterprise devices, or related hardware. Strong network across distributors, regional partners, resellers, and OEM/vendor ecosystems. Demonstrated experience owning revenue targets, forecasting, partner performance, and sales team leadership. Core Skills Deep understanding of IT hardware channel dynamics, distributor management, partner recruitment, key account management, and commercial negotiations. Strong expertise in forecasting, sales operations, pipeline management, and performance review processes. Familiarity with deal registration, partner incentive programs, enablement initiatives, pricing structures, and channel conflict management. Excellent communication, relationship management, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and execution skills. title: Account Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities 
 Bookkeeping & Day-to-Day Accounting Record all financial transactions accurately and on time in Tally sales, purchases, expenses, journal entries, contra entries, and bank/cash transactions. Maintain general ledger, vendor ledger, customer ledger, and employee ledger with regular review and clean-up. Manage petty cash, employee reimbursements, and travel expense settlements as per Company policy. Maintain organized physical and digital records of vouchers, invoices, bills, and supporting documents. Accounts Payable & Receivable Process vendor invoices verify against POs / GRNs / agreements, apply correct GST and TDS, and ensure timely payment cycles. Raise customer/client invoices accurately, with applicable GST, and share with clients along with supporting documents. Follow up with clients on outstanding receivables; track ageing and escalate to the F&A Manager as needed. Reconcile vendor and customer ledgers periodically and issue/obtain confirmations. Bank, Cash & Reconciliations Carry out daily / weekly/monthly bank reconciliations for all bank accounts and credit cards. Support cash-flow tracking and prepare daily fund-position reports for the F&A Manager. Statutory Compliance Support Support GST compliance preparation of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and GSTR-2B reconciliation; coordinate with the F&A Manager/consultants for timely filing under the CGST / SGST / IGST Acts, 2017. Support TDS compliance — deduction at the correct rate, timely deposit, generation of Form 16A, and assistance with quarterly e-TDS returns (Forms 24Q, 26Q, 27Q) under the Income Tax Act, 1961. Support EPF, ESI, Professional Tax (where applicable), and Labour Welfare Fund inputs and challan generation under the EPF & MP Act, 1952; ESI Act, 1948; and applicable state laws. Support advance tax workings, income-tax computations, and ROC / MCA documentation under the Companies Act, 2013, in coordination with the F&A Manager and statutory auditors. Payroll, MIS & Closing Support Support month-end and year-end closing activities — provisioning, prepaid / accruals, depreciation entries, and ledger scrutiny. Prepare routine MIS — receivables ageing, payables ageing, expense trackers, and other reports as required. Support statutory, internal, tax, and GST audits with required schedules, vouchers, and reconciliations; respond to auditor queries in coordination with the F&A Manager. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timeliness and accuracy of bookkeeping and ledger maintenance. Zero / minimal errors in GST and TDS workings; adherence to statutory due dates. Timely bank, vendor, customer, and inter-company reconciliations. Accuracy and timeliness of MIS, payroll inputs, and month-end closing schedules. Quality of audit support and timeliness of query closures. Maintenance of organized, audit-ready records and files. 
 Required Competencies 
 Technical Skills Hands-on expertise in Tally (Tally Prime preferred) vouchers, ledgers, reports, GST and TDS modules, bank reconciliation. Working knowledge of Indian accounting standards (Ind AS / AS basics), GST, TDS, EPF, ESI, and Professional Tax. Strong proficiency in MS Excel (formulas, sorting, filters, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables); working knowledge of MS Word. Good understanding of accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, and basic financial statements. Familiarity with statutory due dates and basic compliance calendars for GST, TDS, EPF, ESI, and other applicable laws. Behavioural Skills Detail-oriented, well-organized, and able to manage multiple tasks against deadlines. High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professional ethics in handling sensitive financial and employee information. Good written and verbal communication skills; able to coordinate with vendors, clients, auditors, and internal stakeholders. Ownership, accountability, and a service-oriented mindset; willingness to learn and take direction from the F&A Manager. Team player with the ability to work calmly under month-end and audit-related deadlines.

Key Skills: TDS,Tally ERP,General Accounting,Ledger Posting,Journal Entries,Book Keeping,Taxation,Voucher Entry

Develop relationships with companies requiring regular coastal and international cargo movement. Identify cargo volumes, origins, destinations and shipping requirements. Develop new accounts and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers. Prepare and maintain a pipeline of potential cargo and chartering opportunities. Meet customers regularly to understand their logistics and transportation requirements. 2. Vessel Chartering Develop and coordinate opportunities for: Time charter Voyage charter Contract of Affreightment (COA) Spot cargo movements Coastal vessel requirements Bulk cargo transportation Project cargo movement Break-bulk cargo Containerised cargo, where applicable The candidate should understand the commercial aspects of vessel chartering, including: Vessel size and type Cargo compatibility Loading/discharging ports Laycan Freight rates Charter-party terms Demurrage/despatch Laytime Port restrictions Draft limitations Bunker considerations Deadweight capacity Vessel positioning Voyage economics 3. Coordinating with shipping lines, vessel owners, NVOCCs and freight forwarders. Supporting negotiation of ocean freight rates. Tracking market movements and freight-rate trends. Vessel Sourcing & Market Intelligence Work closely with the chartering/operations team to identify suitable vessels for customer requirements. Commercial Negotiation Support negotiation of: Freight rates Charter rates Voyage terms Laytime Demurrage/despatch Payment terms Loading/discharge conditions Port costs Bunker-related costs Other commercial terms Coordinate with management, legal and operations teams before finalising contractual commitments. 8. Customer Relationship Management Develop long-term relationships with: Large industrial companies Commodity traders Importers Exporters Manufacturers Infrastructure companies Mining companies Steel companies Cement companies Power companies Fertiliser companies Shipping companies Freight forwarders Logistics companies Regularly visit customers and understand their upcoming cargo programmes. 9. Tender & Contract Business Identify and participate in relevant: Shipping tenders Coastal movement tenders Freight contracts Annual transportation contracts COA opportunities Project cargo contracts Government/PSU cargo movement opportunities Coordinate preparation of commercial quotations, technical information and tender documentation. 10. Profitability & Commercial Analysis Before submitting major quotations, evaluate: Expected revenue Vessel cost Port costs Bunker cost Agency costs Cargo handling costs Canal/other voyage costs, where applicable Demurrage exposure Operational risks Credit/payment terms Expected gross margin Work with the finance and operations teams to ensure that business is commercially viable.

MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Logistics, Shipping or Supply Chain Management will be an advantage. A qualification in Maritime/Shipping studies will be preferred. Experience 38 years of relevant experience in one or more of: Vessel chartering Ship broking Coastal shipping Ocean freight Shipping agency Maritime logistics Freight forwarding Bulk cargo transportation Project cargo Commodity logistics Chartering desk Commercial shipping Candidates with strong customer and cargo relationships will be preferred. Technical & Commercial Knowledge The candidate should have practical knowledge of: Vessel types and capacities Dry bulk / break-bulk / container shipping DWT and vessel specifications Port operations Laycan Laytime Demurrage Despatch Voyage estimation Freight calculation Charter-party basics Cargo documentation Bills of Lading Shipping instructions Port charges Bunker economics Vessel positioning Shipping routes Coastal movement Ocean freight markets Knowledge of GENCON, NYPE, ASBATANKVOY and other commonly used charter-party forms will be an advantage, depending on the cargo and vessel segment. Sales Pipeline & Reporting Maintain a detailed CRM/sales pipeline covering: Lead Customer Requirement Estimated value Charter/freight type Aircraft requirement Route Expected margin Proposal submitted Negotiation stage Confirmation Payment Completed business Repeat-business potential Provide weekly and monthly reports to management.

Commercial Skills The candidate should demonstrate: Strong B2B sales ability Excellent negotiation skills Customer acquisition Rate negotiation Charter costing Freight-rate analysis Proposal preparation Account management Market intelligence Sales forecasting CRM discipline Strong follow-up Commercial judgement 18. Network The ideal candidate should have or be capable of developing a strong professional network among: Helicopter operators Aircraft operators Charter brokers Airlines Cargo airlines GSAs/GSSAs Freight forwarders International agents Corporate travel managers Logistics companies Exporters/importers Project logistics companies High-value cargo customers Existing customer/operator relationships will be an advantage, subject to confidentiality and applicable employment obligations. 19. Job Description Industrial Magnet Sales Executive 
 Position: Industrial Magnet Sales Executive / B2B Sales Executive
 Experience: Fresher / 01 Year
 Qualification: Graduate with Chemistry background
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Location: Noida, Sector 63
 Travel: Willingness to travel across India as required
 About the Role 
We are looking for a motivated and technically interested Industrial Magnet Sales Executive to join our B2B sales team.
The candidate will be responsible for identifying industrial customers, connecting with decision-makers, scheduling appointments, visiting customers, understanding their magnet requirements, and developing business opportunities.
Our products include Rare Earth Magnets, Permanent Magnets, and Neodymium (NdFeB) Magnets used in various industrial applications, including motors, EV motors, BLDC motors, automation, pumps and other manufacturing applications.
A Chemistry background is required because the candidate should be able to understand basic material and magnet-related specifications and communicate effectively with customers.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Identify and research potential B2B industrial customers across India. Generate leads through online research, databases, references, cold calling and other sources. Contact companies and decision-makers to understand their requirements. Schedule appointments before visiting customers . Visit industrial customers and manufacturing units for business development. Understand the customer's product, motor/application and magnet requirement. Identify whether the customer is using NdFeB, ferrite or other permanent magnets . Collect technical requirements such as magnet type, grade, size, shape, coating, tolerance and application. Coordinate with the technical/internal team for drawings, samples, specifications and quotations. Follow up with customers from initial enquiry to quotation, sample approval and order. Maintain accurate records of leads, customer meetings, requirements, quotations and follow-ups. Develop long-term relationships with Purchase, Procurement, R&D, Motor Design and management teams. Achieve assigned sales and lead-generation targets. Travel to different cities and states across India for customer meetings when required. Target Customers / Industries 
The candidate will primarily target manufacturers and companies using magnets in their products, including:
 EV manufacturers and EV motor manufacturers Electric 2-wheeler and 3-wheeler manufacturers EV component and e-axle manufacturers Industrial motor manufacturers BLDC, PMSM and servo motor manufacturers DC motor manufacturers Fan and BLDC fan manufacturers Pump and compressor manufacturers Automation and robotics companies Wind-energy equipment manufacturers Elevator and traction-machine manufacturers Automotive component manufacturers Electronics and sensor manufacturers The sales guide highlights EV/automotive, BLDC fans, industrial motors, wind, elevators, solar pumps, robotics/automation and pumps as key target sectors.
 What the Candidate Needs to Understand 
The candidate does not need extensive prior magnet-sales experience. However, they should be willing to learn about:
 Permanent magnets Rare Earth Magnets Neodymium (NdFeB) Magnets Ferrite Magnets Basic magnet grades and specifications Magnet dimensions, shape and coating Motor applications EV and DC/BLDC/PMSM motor applications Industrial B2B sales processes For example, NdFeB magnets are used in EV motors, industrial motors, robotics, automation, speakers and sensors.
 Candidate Profile 
 Graduate with Chemistry background is mandatory. Freshers are welcome. Strong interest in building a career in B2B/industrial sales . Good communication and interpersonal skills. Confident in speaking with company owners, purchase managers and technical teams. Comfortable making cold calls and following up with customers. Willing to visit factories and industrial areas. Willing to travel anywhere in India for customer meetings. Good basic understanding of Chemistry/materials is preferred. Must be willing to learn technical product specifications. Basic knowledge of MS Excel, email and CRM/lead management is preferred. Having a two-wheeler and a valid driving licence would be an advantage. Sales Process 
The candidate will generally follow this process:
 Lead Generation Customer Calling Requirement Identification Appointment Customer Visit Technical Requirement Collection Quotation Follow-up Sample/Approval Order 
The candidate should focus on understanding the customer's actual application and requirements rather than simply asking whether they need magnets.
 Key Performance Indicators 
Performance will be evaluated based on:
 Number of qualified B2B leads generated Number of customer calls Appointments scheduled Customer visits completed New customer accounts developed Quotations generated Follow-ups and conversion Sales revenue generated Customer relationship development Accuracy of customer/technical information collected Important Requirement 
 This is a field-oriented B2B industrial sales role. Candidates must be comfortable with customer visits and travelling across India. 
The candidate should have the ability to communicate with both commercial and technical contacts , including Purchase Managers, Procurement teams, R&D/Motor Design teams and business owners.

title: Sales Development Representative -  Manager
description:
Job description Sales Development Representative Manager Location: Sector 142, Noida(Full Onsite Role) Fixed Shift : 3:30 PM - 12:30 AM IST. Job description: 
 Role Overview We're looking for an SDR Manager to lead and develop our outbound Sales Development team out of Noida. This role owns ramping new SDRs from day one: building their outbound sequences, coaching their calls, and helping them build a repeatable pipeline-generation process. The role blends enablement, coaching, and outbound strategy. You'll train reps, review their calls, and help shape how the team prospects. 
 The Day-to-Day Design, build, and continuously refine multi-touch outbound sequences (call, email, LinkedIn) for SDRs to execute against target accounts. Own the onboarding and training curriculum for new SDR hires, including cold-call structure, objection handling, discovery questions, and tailoring messaging to the buyer instead of running one template for everyone. Review recorded and live calls regularly; give SDRs specific, actionable feedback and track improvement over time. Run coaching sessions, role-plays, and call breakdowns, both individually and as a team. Partner with SDRs on account research and outreach planning, and make sure handoffs to Account Executives are clean so prospects get a smooth experience from first touch through demo. Set, monitor, and course-correct SDR activity and pipeline metrics, including calls, emails, meetings booked, SQLs, and pipeline contribution, against monthly targets. Work with Marketing to translate campaigns, events, and content into outbound talk tracks, and feed field intelligence (objections, positioning gaps, competitor mentions) back to Marketing and Sales leadership. Keep HubSpot cadences, sequences, and reporting accurate and up to date so pipeline data reflects reality. Identify what's working and what isn't across the team's outbound motion, and adjust strategy accordingly. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile 4-7 years in sales development, inside sales, or SDR leadership, with direct experience managing or mentoring SDRs. Experience selling into the North American market. A track record of building and running outbound sequences that convert: sequences you've actually shipped and iterated on, not just studied. Strong call-coaching ability: you can listen to a call and quickly identify what to fix and how to say it constructively. A strong communicator and writer yourself, able to demonstrate the calls and emails you're asking your team to make. Data-driven: you track team and individual metrics and use them to diagnose problems, not just report numbers. Organized and process-oriented enough to run a training cadence and keep it consistent as the team grows. Comfortable working remotely and managing a distributed or hybrid team's day-to-day. Bonus: hands-on HubSpot expertise (sequences, workflows, reporting). Bonus: background in HR tech, payroll, benefits, or SaaS sales. 
 Perks, Benefits, and Other Details Work schedule: Monday to Friday Shift: 3:30 PM to 12:30 AM IST Competitive compensation based on experience. Paid time off: earned, casual, and sick days. Public holidays and festival leaves. Modern equipment (laptop and necessary tools). Learning and development opportunities. Employee referral program. Collaborative, fast-paced, and iterative startup culture. 

 If interested or you know anyone who will be a great fit please reach out to tapoghna.gupta@risepeople.com or call (+91)7685969211

With a rapidly growing footprint in system integration and managed services, we have strong alliances with leading global OEMs such as VMWare, AWS, Azure, HP, Dell, Lenovo, and Palo Alto.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive revenue generation within the Enterprise Sales vertical, consistently achieving assigned targets.

* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Strategic thinker with strong analytical, problem\-solving, and client management capabilities.



**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to work in a fast\-growing, collaborative organization leading digital transformation.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Open conversations with businesses abroad that need cloud, custom software or managed engineering - and turn them into qualified opportunities. This is the front of our pipeline. You find companies that plausibly need what we do, reach out with something worth reading, and get a first meeting booked. Most of our market is outside India, so the work runs across time zones and is largely written. We do not run a volume-dial operation. Sending a thousand identical emails is easy and it does not work in this market - the buyers are technical, they have seen every template, and a generic pitch gets you filtered. Researching twenty accounts properly and writing twenty specific messages does work, and that is the job. You will be given the ICP, the case studies, and access to the engineers who can answer a technical question on a call. What you bring is persistence and the judgement to tell a real opportunity from a polite conversation. Responsibilities Research and build target account lists that match our ideal customer profile Run outbound across email, LinkedIn and calls, with messaging written for each account rather than blasted Qualify inbound enquiries from the website and route them properly Book and prepare discovery calls for senior team members, with a written brief on the account beforehand Keep the CRM accurate - stage, next step, and honest notes; a clean pipeline is part of the role, not admin around it Follow up systematically on opportunities that go quiet Work with marketing so that campaigns and outbound target the same accounts Report weekly on activity, meetings booked and pipeline created Requirements 1-5 years in business development, inside sales or lead generation - ideally B2B services or technology Genuinely strong written English; you will be writing to decision-makers in the US, UK and Europe Comfortable on the phone and on video calls with people more senior than you Able to research an account and form a point of view about why they would care Organised - you can hold fifty live conversations without losing track of any of them Willing to work hours that overlap with international clients when a call requires it Benefits Direct ownership of your area - no layer of management between you and the outcome Work on accounts and products that ship to international clients A senior team that will review your work properly and tell you what is wrong with it Budget for the tools and certifications the role genuinely needs Five-day week, on-site in Noida ","

title: Sales Executive - Software & SaaS
description:
Carry deals from first call to signature for our custom development work and our SaaS products for local businesses. Where business development opens the door, this role walks through it. You run discovery, shape the proposal with our engineers, handle procurement and negotiation, and close. Two things are being sold. One is custom software and cloud engineering, where the deal is consultative, the buyer is often technical, and the proposal has to survive scrutiny from someone who will have to maintain what we build. The other is our own SaaS products for legal, real estate, HVAC and similar businesses - shorter cycles, demo-led, higher volume. You will need to be credible in both. That does not mean writing code; it means being able to sit on a call with a CTO, understand the constraint they are describing, and know when to bring an engineer in rather than improvise an answer. We would much rather lose a deal than win one on a promise delivery cannot keep. Responsibilities Run discovery calls that surface the real problem, the budget and the decision process Deliver product demos of our SaaS tools, tailored to the prospects industry Build proposals and scopes of work with input from engineering and delivery Handle pricing conversations, negotiation and procurement or security questionnaires Manage your pipeline in the CRM with accurate stages and realistic close dates Forecast monthly, and be honest when a deal is slipping Hand won accounts to delivery with a proper written handover, then stay involved through onboarding Feed what you hear in the market back to the product and marketing teams Requirements 2-5 years closing B2B deals in software development services, SaaS or IT services A track record you can talk through specifically - deal sizes, cycle length, what you closed and what you lost Able to run a discovery call that gets past surface requirements to the actual constraint Comfortable presenting to founders, operations heads and technical buyers Disciplined with CRM hygiene and forecasting Excellent spoken and written English; most clients are outside India Benefits Direct ownership of your area - no layer of management between you and the outcome Work on accounts and products that ship to international clients A senior team that will review your work properly and tell you what is wrong with it Budget for the tools and certifications the role genuinely needs Five-day week, on-site in Noida ","

description:
Open conversations with businesses abroad that need cloud, custom software or managed engineering - and turn them into qualified opportunities. This is the front of our pipeline. You find companies that plausibly need what we do, reach out with something worth reading, and get a first meeting booked. Most of our market is outside India, so the work runs across time zones and is largely written. We do not run a volume-dial operation. Sending a thousand identical emails is easy and it does not work in this market - the buyers are technical, they have seen every template, and a generic pitch gets you filtered. Researching twenty accounts properly and writing twenty specific messages does work, and that is the job. You will be given the ICP, the case studies, and access to the engineers who can answer a technical question on a call. title: Sales Executive - Software & SaaS
description:
Carry deals from first call to signature for our custom development work and our SaaS products for local businesses. Where business development opens the door, this role walks through it. You run discovery, shape the proposal with our engineers, handle procurement and negotiation, and close. Two things are being sold. One is custom software and cloud engineering, where the deal is consultative, the buyer is often technical, and the proposal has to survive scrutiny from someone who will have to maintain what we build.
